The status code used when the user is not authenticated is typically `401 Unauthorized`. This status code indicates that the request has not been applied because the requestor has not supplied the necessary valid authentication credentials.

The status code that typically indicates a user is authenticated but not permitted to access a particular resource is `403 Forbidden`. This means the server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.
